decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's psychiatric care core, is reimbursed by health insurers, and was promoted to the home page in 2024, signaling growing importance.
Senior living counseling has been featured on the home page in both years and acts as a low-cost referral channel into the firm's residential services.
The retail shop gives the sheltered workshop's products a sales outlet and supports its inclusion mission, and its move to the home page in 2024 shows commitment despite thin retail margins.

The meal delivery service is new and only mentioned on the website, so it carries more risk, but it uses existing kitchen capacity and serves the senior target group, so it will likely be given more time.
